subject: Fold cost-awareness + per-move viability gate into ARC execution prompt
description: Extend the OPERATING MODE block in adapter.py zonoid_task_instructions with two generic, task-agnostic additions (no game-specific nouns like timer/path/ticks). (1) Cost/budget awareness as a standing disposition: treat actions as limited and potentially costly; the environment may impose budgets/penalties/limits discoverable only by observing; weigh a plan's cost against observed resource signals; prefer the cheapest plan that could plausibly reach the goal. (2) Per-move viability gate in EXECUTE: before each move do a ONE-LINE viability check (not a re-derivation) over everything observed incl. cost/resource signals; leave EXECUTE on (a) CONTRADICTION (observed result broke the plan) or (b) FORESEEN INFEASIBILITY (check says plan can no longer reach the goal), else play the next move without re-analyzing. Keep all task knowledge out of the prompt (mechanics/win/budget stay discovered-in-memory). Verify: py_compile, --dry-run ok, new generic language present, no game-specific terms added.
